name: Reduce factory Git noise and define evidence retention
description:
Factory review recommendation 19 of 20.

## Context

The review found 181 Rowbly data commits in the last 300 commits and 4.8 MB of tracked merge-evidence JSON.

## Acceptance criteria

- Define retention and cleanup rules for merge evidence while preserving evidence needed to audit outcomes.
- Batch coherent supervisor-event changes where practical without delaying synchronization required by workers.
- Document the role of Data Root synchronization in the single-writer setup and remove unnecessary churn.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.
